mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_profile WHERE class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sp.id) FROM student_profile sp JOIN `class` c ON sp.class_id = CONVERT(c.id, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teacher_homework_submission hs LEFT JOIN teacher_homework_feedback hf ON hs.id = hf.submission_id WHERE hs.homework_id = #{homeworkId} AND (hf.id IS NULL OR hf.status = 0)
SELECT AVG(teacher_score) FROM teacher_homework_feedback WHERE homework_id = #{homeworkId} AND teacher_score IS NOT NULL
SELECT u.id as studentId, sp.real_name as studentName, sp.avatar as studentAvatar, u.username as studentAccount FROM users u LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{studentId}
SELECT sp.id as studentId, sp.real_name as studentName, sp.avatar as studentAvatar FROM student_profile sp WHERE sp.class_id = CONVERT(#{classId}, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci

SELECT DISTINCT sp.id as studentId, sp.real_name as studentName, sp.avatar as studentAvatar FROM student_profile sp JOIN `class` c ON sp.class_id = CONVERT(c.id, CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId}
